Maya (PM): quick thread — customers want a short, guaranteed burst primitive for Dedicated. proposing a lightweight `burst_lease` (duration + token budget + priority). get opinions on API, billing, and runtime constraints.

Roi (Eng): API should be POST /pools/:id/leases, return lease_id + expires_at. enforce pool capacity checks. leases must be non-preemptible while active.

Tess (Runtime): non-preemptible leases mean we reserve slots in autoscaler. implement as ephemeral reservations with TTL. fallback: if overcommit happens, revoke least-recent unpaid leases and credit customer.

Asha (SRE): monitoring: ActiveLeases, LeaseEvictions, LeaseImpactOnP99. canary plan: enable on staging pool, simulate concurrent leases, check p99 degradation <= 1.5x. rollback rule: if eviction_rate > 5% disable new leases.

Ben (Billing): billing model: prorated charge for lease duration. include `lease_charge` label in invoice CSV and lease_id column. customers must explicitly opt-in.

Maya (PM): beta launch criteria: API + Console button, billing label, autoscaler enforcement, pilot with 3 customers for 72h with telemetry within thresholds.

Roi (Eng): owners & ETA: API (Roi 3d), autoscaler integration (Tess 2w), metrics + dashboard (Asha 1w).

Maya (PM): approved for prototype. keeping this thread for updates. ping @Maya for blockers. :rocket:
